name: es30-sampler-objects
title: Sampler objects: sampling state separate from textures
summary: Sampler objects override a texture's filters, wrap modes and LOD range; one texture bound to two units with two samplers in one draw; unbinding, deleting and modifying bound samplers; round trips of glSamplerParameter{i,f,iv,fv} through glGetSamplerParameter{i,f}v, SAMPLER_BINDING per unit, glIsSampler life cycle and the defined errors.
spec: ES 3.0 §3.8.2 Sampler Objects (GenSamplers, BindSampler, SamplerParameter*, DeleteSamplers; sampler state supersedes texture state while bound)
ES 3.0 §3.8.7 Texture Parameters (Table 3.20 legal values; ES 3.2 §8.10 for the INVALID_ENUM error), §3.8.14 Texture State (initial values), Table 6.10 (sampler state)
ES 3.0 §3.8.13.1 Effects of Sampler Objects on Texture Completeness, §3.9.2.1 (incomplete texture samples as (0, 0, 0, 1))

ES 3.0 §3.8.10 Texture Minification (3.8.10.1 LOD clamping, equation 3.18; 3.8.10.2 Table 3.22 wrap modes and bilinear weights; 3.8.10.4 mipmap level selection, equations 3.23-3.25), §3.8.11 Magnification
ES 3.0 §2.3.1 Data Conversion For State-Setting Commands
GLSL ES 3.00 §4.1.7 Samplers, §8.8 Texture Lookup Functions

api.glGenSamplers: sampler names for the cells (one is left in its initial state: it makes texture A incomplete on its unit); glIsSampler is TRUE for a generated but never used name; names reused after deletion
api.glDeleteSamplers: deleting a sampler that is bound (to one or to two units) unbinds it and the cell shows the texture's own state again; unused names and 0 are ignored without error
api.glBindSampler: sampler on a unit overrides the texture bound there (pixels match the CPU sampler); glBindSampler(unit, 0) restores the texture's state; INVALID_OPERATION for a deleted or never generated sampler, INVALID_VALUE for unit = MAX_COMBINED_TEXTURE_IMAGE_UNITS
api.glIsSampler: FALSE for 0 and for never generated names, TRUE after glGenSamplers, FALSE after glDeleteSamplers
api.glSamplerParameteri: MIN/MAG filter and WRAP_S/T of the sampler cells (pixels), MAX_LOD = 0 (pixel: level 0), MIN_LOD = -2 on a float parameter (read back as -2.0), COMPARE_FUNC read back; illegal values -> INVALID_ENUM and the old value stays; sampler 0 -> INVALID_OPERATION
api.glSamplerParameterf: MIN_LOD = 3 (pixel: level 3), MIN_LOD = -3.25 read back exactly, MAG_FILTER and WRAP_R given as floats; deleted sampler -> INVALID_OPERATION
api.glSamplerParameteriv: WRAP_S = MIRRORED_REPEAT in the right half of the split cell (pixels), COMPARE_MODE read back
api.glSamplerParameterfv: MIN_LOD = MAX_LOD = 1.5 with LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR (pixel: half level 1, half level 2), MAX_LOD = 7.5 and WRAP_T read back
api.glGetSamplerParameteriv: initial values (NEAREST_MIPMAP_LINEAR, LINEAR, REPEAT x3, NONE, LEQUAL), round trips of every enum parameter, sampler MAG_FILTER unchanged by glTexParameter; never generated sampler -> INVALID_OPERATION
api.glGetSamplerParameterfv: initial MIN_LOD/MAX_LOD (-1000, 1000), LOD round trips, an enum parameter returned as float; sampler 0 -> INVALID_OPERATION
api.glGetIntegerv: SAMPLER_BINDING per unit via glActiveTexture (set, unbound, deleted while bound to two units), MAX_COMBINED_TEXTURE_IMAGE_UNITS
api.glActiveTexture: selects the unit whose SAMPLER_BINDING / texture binding is queried or set
api.glGenTextures: textures A, B (4x4) and M (64x64, 7 levels)
api.glBindTexture: texture on units 0 and 1; the same texture on two units in one draw (split cells)
api.glTexImage2D: RGBA8 uploads of A, B and of each of the 7 mipmap levels of M; observed through pixels
api.glTexParameteri: own MIN/MAG filter and WRAP of A and B (observed when no sampler is bound); changed while a sampler is bound: the texture changes (glGetTexParameteriv) and the sampler does not
api.glTexParameterf: own MIN_LOD = 3 of texture M: level 3 without sampler, overridden by a sampler
api.glGetTexParameteriv: MAG_FILTER of the texture after glTexParameteri while a sampler is bound
api.glGetUniformLocation: u_tex_a, u_tex_b, u_uv_scale, u_uv_offset, u_split located
api.glUniform1i: sampler uniforms hold texture unit indices 0 and 1; u_split selects the two-unit mode
api.glUniform2f: texture coordinate scale and offset; probed positions follow them
api.glDrawArrays: TRIANGLE_STRIP quad per cell from gl_VertexID
api.glViewport: cell viewports; probed pixels fall inside them
api.glReadPixels: RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE readback of every cell compared with the CPU sampler or the expected mip level color

visual_review.notes: Window-filling layout reviewed on llvmpipe captures at 640x400 and 800x800 and the 256x256 radeonsi es-max capture. The 4x4 cells now partition the whole surface (rectangular at 640x400). Bottom row: hard 3x3 tiles (A own NEAREST/REPEAT), smooth clamped streaks (A + LINEAR/CLAMP sampler), split cell with hard tiles left and a solid black right half (incomplete), smooth clamped streaks (B own). Second row: hard tiles, split cell tiled left / smooth mirrored-clamped right, two identical smooth halves, two identical hard clamped halves. Third row: hard clamped streaks, smooth 3x3 tiles, green (level 1), yellow (level 3). Top row: red (level 0), teal mix, yellow, green. LOD cells are flat at every size; no gaps between cells.
